title: Cases of Creators Seeking Help for Plagiarising of Their Artworks and Resolution for Such Cases
what_it_is: Cases of Creators Seeking Help for Plagiarising of Their Artworks and Resolution for Such Cases

sections.label: Copyright disputes and mediation options
sections.summary: About one in four sessions touched on copyright infringement, and IPOS offers legal clinics and mediation support programmes, including reduced rates with WIPO.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: About one in four of the sessions touched on copyright infringement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Besides IPOS’ IP legal clinics, creators can consider alternative dispute resolution (ADR), such as mediation which is often more cost-effective and expeditious, compared to litigation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: IPOS runs various mediation support programmes, including collaborating with the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) Arbitration and Mediation Center to promote ADR by offering reduced rates.

sections.label: IPOS and VICPA memorandum of understanding
sections.summary: IPOS signed a three-year MOU with VICPA to support creative freelance professionals and young creators in IP education, capacity building and resource sharing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: In addition, IPOS recently signed a three-year memorandum of understanding (MOU) with the Visual, Audio, Creative Content Professionals Association (Singapore), or VICPA, of which I believe the hon Member Ms See is part of the leadership team, to provide support to creative freelance professionals and young creators in the areas of IP education and management, capacity building and resource sharing.

sections.label: Support for less means creators
sections.summary: Creators from less means can seek legal aid if means and merits tests are met, use complimentary IPOS legal clinics, and VICPA capacity-building initiatives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: In relation to supporting creators who come from less means and how do they enforce their rights, one thing to note is that, like for all fellow Singaporeans, they are entitled to legal aid as long as the means test and the merits test are satisfied.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: In addition, as I mentioned in my answer to the hon Member Ms See, we have been running legal clinics for quite some time and the businesses may wish to avail themselves of these legal clinics which are run on a complimentary basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: In addition, IPOS has already commenced some of the capacity-building initiatives, for example, the MOU with VICPA and hopefully, this may be a suitable avenue as well for these creators.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: Perhaps this is an area that we can work on with VICPA and other businesses.
